Author: Aravind Kumar

 Nashik Municipal Corporation & Anr. Appellant
 Versus
 The Bombay Xaverian Corporation Pvt. Ltd. & Ors. Responden
 O R D E R
1.
Delay condoned.

2. Leave granted.
3.
The only issue is with respect to the entitlement of the respondents for compensation of the acquired land.

The incidental issue that may arise in the event of holding the entitlement for compensation is on the application of the requisite law, that is, the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (for short the Act,
2013), the law which was in force inter se parties at the relevant point of time.
4. On perusal of the sale deed, we find that there is a specific clause which gives option to the respondents either to choose FSI, TDR or monetary compensation.
5.
